name: Sint Maarten
summary: The Dutch half of an island whose partition repeatedly disappeared.
notes: The 1648 division is represented by two tracks, one for each modern jurisdiction. During French military occupations in 1781–1784 and 1795–1801, Dutch civil officials continued working.

events.title: A Dutch salt colony
events.detail: Dutch colonists established a settlement in the south.

events.title: Spain takes the settlement
events.detail: A Spanish expedition expelled the Dutch.

events.title: The island is divided
events.detail: The Concordia agreement provided for Dutch and French zones after Spanish withdrawal.

events.title: France occupies both halves
events.detail: War temporarily erased the administrative partition.

events.title: Dutch forces take the island
events.detail: A Dutch expedition briefly captured both zones.

events.title: France returns
events.detail: French forces again controlled the island.

events.title: Colonial administration collapses
events.detail: Evacuation and war left no organized island government.

events.title: French government resumes
events.detail: France initially controlled both parts.

events.title: Colonists evacuate
events.detail: Both administrations withdrew during renewed war.

events.title: Dutch government resumes
events.detail: The Dutch controlled both zones until France returned to the north in 1715.

events.title: French occupation of the Dutch half
events.detail: The American Revolutionary War disrupted the division.

events.title: Britain takes the island
events.detail: A British occupation followed the capture of nearby Dutch colonies.

events.title: France displaces Britain
events.detail: French forces returned, with Dutch civil officials remaining.

events.title: The Dutch zone restored
events.detail: The peace settlement restored the divided administration.

events.title: French military control
events.detail: French commissioners arrived; Dutch civil administration continued under French military power.

events.title: Britain occupies both zones
events.detail: War brought a new British occupation.

events.title: Dutch government restored
events.detail: The Peace of Amiens restored the prewar arrangement.

events.title: British occupation returns
events.detail: British troops held the Dutch zone until 1816.

events.title: The Dutch return
events.detail: The final British occupation ended.

events.title: A country within the Kingdom
events.detail: Sint Maarten became an autonomous constituent country.
